name: FireCMS MCP
description: Browse and edit Firestore data, create and change FireCMS collections, infer schemas from existing documents and manage project users from Claude or Cursor, for Firebase teams.

skills.name: Query Documents
skills.description: Queries Firestore documents with filters, ordering and pagination, and creates, updates, deletes, counts or exports them.

skills.name: Infer Collections
skills.description: Infers collection schemas from sampled Firestore documents and saves them as FireCMS collections, skipping mapped paths.

skills.name: Edit Collection Schema
skills.description: Creates or updates collection schemas and single properties, or generates and modifies a schema from a prompt.

skills.name: Manage Users
skills.description: Lists project users and their roles, invites users, changes roles or removes users, with the admin role required.

skills.name: Connect Firebase Project
skills.description: Connects an existing Firebase project to FireCMS; the local server can also enable its APIs and create the Firestore database.
